# A company address with its second line left out.
#
# What this fixture produces: a company whose address holds `42 Example Street`,
# an empty second line, and `Springfield ON`. The export writes the two lines
# that hold something, each under the index it has, and no `addr[1]`.
#
# Verified by tests/integration/test_a_company_address_keeps_the_index_of_each_line.py.
company
	name: "Example Co"
	addr[0]: "42 Example Street"
	addr[2]: "Springfield ON"
